name: Biscus VR
summary:
Swing, climb, flip, and run for your life.

Biscus VR is a fast multiplayer game where you move with your hands: push off the ground, climb any wall, backflip off ledges and ride ziplines and swing ropes across the map. Every lobby votes on the next round, so no two sessions play the same.

10 GAME MODES
- Horror: one player becomes a huge Monster that can grab, throw and eat survivors. Find the power cells, power the generator and escape the hospital.
